transcribed_question:
A IDENTIFY THE STRUCTURE PINNED "GREEN"
B WHAT IS NERVE SUPPLY TO THE STRUCTURE PINNED "BLUE"

marker.description: Blue-headed pin indicating a structure in the inguinal region

main_explanation: The specimen is a prosection of the inguinal region. The blue pin indicates a nerve structure, which the answer key identifies as the genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve.

supporting_question.question: What is the nerve supply to the structure pinned blue?
options: It is a branch of the femoral nerve
It is a branch of the obturator nerve
It is a branch of the lumbar plexus (L1-L2)
It is a branch of the sacral plexus
supporting_question.explanation: The genitofemoral nerve arises directly from the anterior rami of the first and second lumbar spinal nerves (L1-L2), which are part of the lumbar plexus.
